summary: Backend testing complete for Elite Football AI Scout — 23/23 tests passed including the critical Gemini multimodal video analysis flow. All auth flows (signup/login/me/role-checks), public price settings, video upload+free preview generation via Gemini 2.5 Pro, locked report semantics (402 for unpaid PDF/generate-full), report ownership/admin-access enforcement, Stripe checkout session creation + status poll, and full admin surface (stats, users, reports, payments, price update, manual unlock, delete) all work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1060 lines and mixes auth/AI/PDF/payments/admin — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, reports.py, payments.py, admin.py) and a pdf_service.py for maintainability (>700 line guideline).

Webhook endpoint POST /api/webhook/stripe is correctly defined but is gated by Stripe signature verification — in tests we cannot exercise it; on the public preview URL Stripe cannot reach it. Document this in README, and consider an /api/payments/reconcile admin endpoint to force-mark paid when webhook can't fire.
TestUploadPreview cleans up only via admin delete — there is no public DELETE user endpoint. Acceptable for MVP but consider a /api/reports/{id} DELETE for owners.
Background param is declared in upload_video_and_create_preview but unused — minor lint nit (can be removed).
Static /uploads is mounted publicly without auth — anyone with the filename (UUID) can stream the uploaded video. For premium SaaS this should be signed-URL gated.
No file-size limit enforced on upload (FastAPI default; nginx may allow large body). Add explicit max-size check (e.g., reject > 200MB) before saving to disk.
JWT_SECRET_KEY is a hard-coded long string in .env which is fine for dev; ensure it's rotated for production.
Admin password is reset on every startup from env — by design (idempotent seed) but worth documenting since rotating the env var changes the live password.
Public price endpoint returns currency string 'dkk' lowercase while Stripe currency is also 'dkk' — consistent; good.
_serialize_report omits full_report when include_full=False which correctly prevents data leakage.
test_credentials: admin@elitescout.com / Admin@2026!Elite (seeded on startup). Test user is created dynamically with TEST_user_<uuid>@example.com.
seed_data_creation: Admin user auto-seeded by backend on startup. Tests create one ephemeral TEST_user_* account and one report which is later deleted via admin DELETE; the test user account remains in DB (no delete-user endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green. Sample video used: /tmp/sample.mp4 (788KB Big Buck Bunny clip downloaded from w3schools — re-download with: curl -sL -o /tmp/sample.mp4 https://www.w3schools.com/html/mov_bbb.mp4). Gemini 2.5 Pro preview generation takes ~15-20s per call on this small mp4. Stripe checkout works in test mode (sk_test_emergent); payment_status returns 'unpaid' until checkout is completed in a real browser — webhook can't be exercised from preview env so to test paid flow end-to-end, manually toggle is_paid=true on the report doc in MongoDB, or use admin unlock endpoint.
